description_en: Efficient detection and recognition of printed text in image documents for Latin-script scenarios, supporting multiple basic features such as rotation, tables, and text coordinates.
description_zh: 针对拉丁语系的图片文档场景下印刷体高效检测和识别，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-latin --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/zxllbh/%E6%8B%89%E4%B8%81%E8%AF%AD%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --output-char-info false --need-rotate false --output-table false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeLatin

parameters.help_en: Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; Base64 encoding is not supported)
parameters.help_zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Binary image file, up to 10 MB in size. Either this parameter or the URL parameter must be provided. When using HTTP, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body. When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh: 图片二进制文件，最大10MB，与URL二选一。 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body 中上传即可。 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output character-level recognition results
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出单字识别结果
parameters.name: output_char_info

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation. Rotation is automatically applied in structured detection, mixed-layout scenarios, and education-related scenarios, so this parameter does not need to be set in those cases. The response includes the rotation angle information.
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要自动旋转功能（结构化检测、混贴场景、教育相关场景会自动做旋转，无需设置），返回角度信息
parameters.name: need_rotate

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output table recognition results, including cell information
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出表格识别结果，包含单元格信息
parameters.name: output_table

v1_body_parameters.help_en: Binary image file, up to 10 MB in size. Either this parameter or the URL parameter must be provided. When using HTTP, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body. When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body
